description: Source code for the etcd client v3 key-value interface, defining the KV interface, response types, and implementation methods for interacting with etcd's key-value store.

classes.name: kv
classes.description: Implementation of the KV interface, providing methods to interact with etcd's key-value store.

methods.name: Put
methods.description: Inserts or updates a key-value pair in etcd.

methods.name: Compact
methods.description: Compacts the etcd key-value store up to a specified revision.

methods.name: Do
methods.description: Executes a single operation (Put, Get, Delete, etc.) on the key-value store.
